interpretation.paths: Only valid completed audit trajectories with bound executed UI actions enter normalized edit distances; objective success is not required. Partial and invalid prefixes remain separately visible.
interpretation.controls: Route tokens use audit route, action type and unique matching reviewer control text; local candidate IDs never identify controls across images. These are reviewer-only labels.
interpretation.screens: Pair comparisons use the first occurrence per run per exact current image and exact sorted candidate criteria bindings. Other context and whole histories are not asserted equal. Candidate annotations can exclude otherwise similar opportunities.
interpretation.probabilities: Raw model probabilities and their total variation are descriptive distribution values, not confidence, human frequencies or comprehension.
interpretation.reasons: Model-reported categories are not internal cognition or verified explanations.
interpretation.opportunities: Absent, invalid and incomplete opportunities are not imputed as successful avoidance. Observed changes and successful delivery have separate denominators.
interpretation.consistency: Persona tendencies are hypotheses, not mandatory paths. Qualitative consistency, contradictions and unexercised traits require separate evidence review.
interpretation.limits: Within and between distances are descriptive pair means with correlated pairs, unequal opportunities and small sample sizes; no naturalness, human-fidelity or causal verdict is computed.
